title: Czech building-materials distributor Pro-Doma reportedly hit by cyberattack, back to paper
date_note: The page gives only its publication day (25 November 2026); no earlier date for the attack is stated.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source (Czech outlet); no city given
summary: Hospodářské noviny reports that Pro-Doma, a Czech building-materials distributor, was hit by an extensive cyberattack on its internal system; staff issue documents by hand and customers can pay only in cash. A second article's headline says hackers got in through one employee who used the same password for work and for a home appliance. No attacker is named.
plain: Hospodářské noviny reports that an extensive cyberattack on Pro-Doma's internal system forced the Czech building-materials distributor to issue documents by hand and take cash only.
exec: Per Hospodářské noviny, a cyberattack left Pro-Doma issuing documents by hand, taking cash only, and unable to hand over goods ordered earlier.
impact: Handwritten documents, cash-only payments and goods ordered earlier not handed over, per Hospodářské noviny.

validation.note: Only Hospodářské noviny (two articles, one publisher) read; parts are paywalled. Pro-Doma's own statement was not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: 'cannot deliver goods' changed to 'cannot hand over goods ordered earlier'; 'large' to 'extensive' and 'internal system' as the page words it; date, single_source and status checked against the HN page
